categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and modifies common settings utilities in src/common/settings.cpp and src/common/args.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents file corruption on unexpected shutdown by making JSON persistence atomic via temporary files and RenameOver. As noted in the description, writing banlist.json previously wrote directly to the destination, risking an empty or truncated file if interrupted.
